welcome.title: Welcome to TunaOS Tromsø
welcome.description: TunaOS Tromsø — a KDE Plasma desktop built on freedesktop-sdk with bootc-powered atomic updates.

features.title: KDE Plasma 6
features.description: A complete KDE Plasma 6 desktop with Qt6, KDE Frameworks, and KDE applications.

community.title: Atomic Updates

completed.description: Select your disk and install TunaOS Tromsø.
